"The chart illustrates the **Evolution of Market Devaluation Expectations** based on ROFEX future contracts, measured in percent month-over-month (m/m).

### Chart Specifications
*   **Title:** Evolution of Market Devaluation Expectations
*   **Subtitle:** (ROFEX future contracts, percent, m/m)
*   **Vertical Axis (Y):** Percent, ranging from 0 to 18 in increments of 2.
*   **Horizontal Axis (X):** Monthly timeline for the year 2024 (Jan-24 to Dec-24).
*   **Data Series:**
    *   **end-Dec (Light Gray):** Expectations as of the end of December 2023.
    *   **end-Feb (Light Blue):** Expectations as of the end of February 2024.
    *   **end-May (Dark Blue):** Expectations as of the end of May 2024.

### Data Points (Estimated)
The table below provides approximate values extracted from the chart's data points:

| Month (2024) | end-Dec (%) | end-Feb (%) | end-May (%) |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| Jan | 4.9 | - | - |
| Feb | 5.8 | - | - |
| Mar | 11.4 | 4.6 | - |
| Apr | 10.5 | 7.0 | - |
| May | 9.6 | 6.7 | 2.1 |
| Jun | 7.2 | 7.6 | 3.1 |
| Jul | 7.3 | 8.7 | 3.5 |
| Aug | 6.9 | 7.3 | 4.0 |
| Sep | 6.4 | 7.2 | 4.2 |
| Oct | 6.7 | 5.9 | 4.1 |
| Nov | 6.9 | 6.3 | 4.2 |
| Dec | - | 5.6 | 4.2 |

### General Trends
*   **Reduction in Expectations:** There is a clear downward trend in devaluation expectations over time. The "end-May" series is significantly lower than the previous "end-Dec" and "end-Feb" projections.
*   **Peaks:** The "end-Dec" expectations peaked sharply in March 2024 at over 11%. The "end-Feb" expectations peaked later, in July 2024, at approximately 8.7%.
*   **Stabilization:** By the end of 2024, the most recent "end-May" data shows expectations stabilizing at a much lower level of approximately 4.2% m/m."
